description: PLAYBACK-HFR-CONFORM-DEFAULT-1: the high-frame-rate conform leg on the consented 59.94 fps clip (by id only), windowed AND full screen, on cuda, scale 1, Look Assist Cinematic: each is its display-matrix cell with the clip changed.
